# API Design Principles, REST Style Guide & OpenAPI Validator (2026)

> Practical API design principles handbook (32 rules backed by RFC 9110, RFC 9457, RFC 8594, IETF Idempotency-Key, Google AIP, and OWASP API Top 10) paired with a zero-dependency OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON & YAML validator, breaking-change diff checker, GitHub Action, and SARIF exporter (Verified: 2026-11-16).

## Summary
`api-design-tools/api-design-principles` turns API style rules into executable checks. It combines a structured rule catalog (`rules.json`), industry presets (`presets/google-aip.json`, `presets/stripe-style.json`, `presets/owasp-api-top10.json`, `presets/strict-public-api.json`), a zero-dependency Python 3.9+ CLI linter (`api_validator.py`), a composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`), and a browser validator (`https://api-design-tools.github.io/api-design-principles/`).

## Automated OpenAPI Rules (ADP-001 to ADP-022)
- Naming & Paths (`ADP-001` to `ADP-004`): Plural resource nouns without CRUD verbs (`/v1/orders`), lowercase `kebab-case`, no trailing slashes, explicit major version prefix.
- HTTP Method Semantics (`ADP-005` to `ADP-007`, `ADP-020`): `GET`/`HEAD` must never declare `requestBody`; `POST` creation returns `201` (`Location`) or `202`; `DELETE` returns `204`/`202` without required body; `PATCH` (`application/merge-patch+json`) + `ETag`/`If-Match` for concurrency.
- Error Handling (`ADP-008` to `ADP-009`): Explicit `4xx` responses using `RFC 9457` Problem Details (`application/problem+json`).
- Pagination (`ADP-010` to `ADP-011`): Bounded pagination on collection `GET` endpoints; prefer O(1) cursor pagination over `OFFSET`.
- Idempotency & Rate Limiting (`ADP-012`, `ADP-013`, `ADP-018`): `Idempotency-Key` header on `POST` mutations; `429` + `Retry-After` + `RateLimit-*` headers; `Deprecation` & `Sunset` headers (`RFC 8594`).
- Security & AI/MCP Readiness (`ADP-014` to `ADP-017`, `ADP-019`, `ADP-021`, `ADP-022`): `https://` servers, `components.securitySchemes`, no credentials in query strings, unique `operationId` + `summary`, `example` payloads, `maxLength`/`maxItems` (`OWASP API4:2023`), ISO 8601 UTC `date-time`.

## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage
- Lint JSON or YAML spec: `python3 api_validator.py --spec examples/orders-api-good.openapi.yaml --preset strict-public-api`
- Breaking-change diff: `python3 api_validator.py --diff base.yaml head.yaml --format markdown`
- SARIF 2.1.0 output: `python3 api_validator.py --spec openapi.json --format sarif --output api-design.sarif`
- GitHub Action: `uses: api-design-tools/api-design-principles@v1`
